[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Melia, is it? How did you get here, then?[XENO:n ]
What, is there no one with you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I must apologise, but my situation does not concern you.[XENO:n ]
And I shall not be divulging anything to common passers-by.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

But if I were to be so bold, I'm guessing that you didn't come[XENO:n ]
here alone and you weren't just taking an afternoon nap.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And what, may I ask, are you doing here? It is rare[XENO:n ]
to see Homs venture this deep into Makna Forest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We're travelling to the head of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
We've got a long journey ahead of us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]The head of the Giant God?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We were just figuring out how to get there[XENO:n ]
when we found you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I see. Then permit me to return the favour[XENO:n ]
by aiding you in your quest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]There is only one path to the head of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
It is the path that leads to Eryth Sea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]So this Eryth Sea is at the head of the Giant God?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If you would be kind enough to escort me[XENO:n ]
out of the forest, I will show you the way.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Thank you, Melia! I'm Shulk.[XENO:n ]
Pleased to meet you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk, ah yes. Likewise.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]She's a bit high and mighty, but she's a[XENO:n ]
Homs too, right? Why is she here alone?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Ain't got a clue. Ask her yourself.[XENO:n ]
I'm not good with her posh accent.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
